Definition: Is artificial intelligence integrated into the data exchange for data quality, fraud detection or predictive analytics
Comments: No evidence found of AI/analytics integrated into Zambia's data exchange platform or Zamportal. National e-Government Plan (NeGP) 2023-2026 and Data Interoperability Standards 2024 do not reference AI deployment in data exchange operations.
redteam_note: No data year recorded — provenance/recency unknown.
revision_notes: The two cited sources (NeGP 2023-2026, Data Interoperability Standards 2024) could not be re-fetched directly (site returns 403 to crawlers) but their described content — no mention of AI in data exchange operations — is corroborated by fresher, independently-verified evidence: Zambia's National Artificial Intelligence Strategy 2024-2026 (Ministry of Technology and Science, launched November 2024) states the country's AI ecosystem is 'relatively fragmented', that 'there is no centralised platform for AI data aggregation or model deployment', and lists a national AI/data-sharing platform as a future opportunity rather than a current capability. A private firm (Neosoft) has proposed AI-based fraud detection to the Anti-Corruption Commission, but this is an unconfirmed pitch, not an operational integration with the government data exchange (GSB/Zamportal). Because authoritative, dated evidence now positively supports 'No' rather than 'Unknown', the code is revised from 0 to 1. The original row also lacked a Year despite citing two sources; the revised year reflects the newest authoritative source consulted.
revised_comments: Zambia's data exchange platform (the Government Service Bus/Zamportal, coordinated by the Smart Zambia Institute) does not currently incorporate artificial intelligence or advanced analytics for data quality assurance, fraud detection, or predictive analytics. The National e-Government Plan 2023-2026 and the Public Service ICT Data Interoperability Standards make no reference to AI functionality within data exchange operations. The National Artificial Intelligence Strategy 2024-2026 describes Zambia's AI ecosystem as fragmented, with no centralised platform for AI data aggregation or model deployment; development of such a platform is identified as a future opportunity rather than an existing capability.

Definition: Level of public transparency regarding data exchange operations, governance, and data sharing agreements
Comments: SZI publishes Data Interoperability Standards, NeGP, and annual reports publicly. CDPI MOU and DPI case studies published. NeGP 2023-2026 is a public document with monitoring framework. Moderate transparency through official SZI/government publications. No real-time dashboard.
redteam_note: Value Name differs from the scale label — usually cosmetic.
revision_notes: Confirmed via the Smart Zambia Institute (SZI) official website: publicly available documents include the Electronic Government Act No. 41 of 2021, the National e-Government Plan 2023-2026, the Strategic Plan 2023, the Service Delivery Charter, and Statutory Instrument No. 43 of 2023 — consistent with the scale's 'Moderate = Annual Reports' tier (periodic official planning/strategy publications) rather than 'High = Public Dashboard & Reports'. No live public dashboard on data exchange operations, usage metrics, or data-sharing agreements was identified in the search. The Value Name uses a dash ('Moderate - Annual Reports') rather than the scale's '=' formatting; this is cosmetic only and does not affect the score. Value Code of 3 is confirmed unchanged.
revised_comments: Zambia's Smart Zambia Institute (SZI), the agency responsible for the data exchange (Government Service Bus/Zamportal), maintains a public website through which it publishes governance and policy documents, including the Electronic Government Act No. 41 of 2021, the National e-Government Plan 2023-2026, the associated Strategic Plan, the Service Delivery Charter, and Statutory Instrument No. 43 of 2023. This constitutes moderate public transparency through periodic official publications, comparable to annual reporting, though no live public dashboard tracking data exchange operations or data-sharing agreements is available.
